title: PNP vows stronger action against perpetrators of attacks on journalists

blocks.text: MANILA – The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Tuesday reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening accountability mechanisms and ensuring that offenses committed against members of the press are properly addressed. PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio C. Nartatez Jr. said the PNP remains committed to pursuing offenders who threaten, harass, or attack journalists, ensuring that criminal cases are properly prepared for prosecution. Nartatez made the statement as the Philippines joined the global observance of the International Day to End Impunity for Crimes against Journalists, which highlights the need to protect media workers and hold perpetrators accountable for attacks against them.
